summary.intent: Clean up stale todos by moving items completed during previous development phases to the done state.
summary.outcome: Identified 8 todos already addressed by completed phases (24, 25) and PR #368, moved them to done, leaving 6 genuinely future work items, then committed and pushed the cleanup.

repo: Todos are tracked in a file-based system with a 'done' state that must be manually updated after work is merged.
Work was organized into numbered phases (20, 24, 25) with PR #368 representing in-flight SDK work.
Phase 25 covered Tauri updater and TEE file enrollment; Phase 24 covered 401 interceptor, recovery e2e tests, IPNS auto-repair, and device registry v2 schema.
workflow: Todos extracted into phase-based work items can become orphaned and need periodic reconciliation against completed phases.
It's worth auditing todo state after completing a phase to catch items that were implicitly resolved.

friction: Todo state was not kept in sync during phase work, requiring a retroactive cleanup pass.
Ambiguity about when to mark a todo done — at implementation time vs. after CI/merge (e.g., PR #368 not yet merged).
open_items: PR #368 (extract-vault-key-blob-ipns-publish-into-sdk) is not yet merged; its associated todo was moved to done optimistically before CI passes.
6 todos remain as genuine future work items.
